title: OppSalesMethodologyItem - Data API
description: Represents the scored criteria for an opportunity's associated sales methodology. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

IsLocked.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsLocked.description: Indicates if the opportunity's sales methodology criteria is locked (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

MayEdit.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
MayEdit.description: Indicates whether a user can edit the opportunity's sales methodology criteria. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the opportunity's sales methodology stage or criteria.

Note.description: This field stores details you enter when updating or scoring the opportunity's sales methodology stage or criteria.

OppSalesMethodologyId.description: The ID of the opportunity's sales methodology. This field is a relationship field.

SalesMethodologyDefItemId.description: The ID of the sales methodology stage or criteria. This field is a relationship field.

Value.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Value.description: The value associated with the opportunity's scored sales methodology stage or criteria.

special_access_rules:
To access this object turn on the userHasSalesMethodologyEnabled, OrgPreferences, SalesMethodologyPref, and PipelineInspectorUser permissions. To create, edit, or delete records, users must own the associated opportunity's parent opportunity.
